description: This file defines the BatchBuilder class used for constructing batch process configurations in Drupal, including setting callbacks, messages, queue options, and converting the configuration to an array.

classes.name: BatchBuilder
classes.description: A class for building batch process configurations, including setting operations, callbacks, messages, queue options, and serialization to array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes default messages for the batch builder.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the batch process.

methods.name: setFinishCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be called upon batch completion.

methods.name: setInitMessage
methods.description: Sets the message displayed during batch initialization.

methods.name: setProgressMessage
methods.description: Sets the message displayed during batch progress.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the message displayed if an error occurs.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the file containing callback functions and includes it.

methods.name: setLibraries
methods.description: Sets libraries to include during batch processing.

methods.name: setUrlOptions
methods.description: Sets URL options for redirect URLs.

methods.name: setProgressive
methods.description: Sets whether the batch runs progressively.

methods.name: setQueue
methods.description: Overrides the default queue with a specified queue class.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Adds an operation (callback and arguments) to the batch.

methods.name: isSetIdRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a set ID has been registered during the request.

methods.name: registerSetId
methods.description: Registers a set ID for the batch.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the BatchBuilder object into an array representation.
